title: Six Paths Awakening
body:
Syntax: sixpaths [on|off|status]

At level 75, an Indra reincarnation learns Six Paths Rinnegan, Almighty Push and Universal Pull. An Ashura reincarnation learns Six Paths Sage Mode, Six Paths Rasenshuriken and Truth-Seeking Orb Barrage. This unlock works for all combat classes and also catches eligible returning players at login. The two lineages cannot use each other's exclusive techniques.

Activation costs 40 Chakra. While active, pay 18 Chakra every ten seconds outside combat, or 24 Chakra and 8 Stamina each combat round. The form ends when resources run out, you fall, or you log back in. Turn it off with sixpaths off. Summon Sage Mode and Six Paths mode cannot stack. At 0-100% mode mastery, gain 10-20% outgoing damage, 5-15% incoming damage reduction, and +5-10 accuracy. Practice stops at the normal 50% cap; paid maintenance can raise mode mastery toward 100%. Attack techniques have their own normal proficiency, costs and cooldowns. See each individual technique's help for details.

Use perform <technique> <target>; your mode must be active. These powers use ordinary PvE/PvP targeting, safe-zone rules and damage handling. Birth bonuses and reincarnation status stay permanent when the mode ends.

Date: 2026-10-11
